acceptanceCriteria: The only publishable package is questpie@4.0.0-beta.1. Its public root, declaration, and questpie CLI are installable from one tarball; compiler and Runtime bytes are vendored private implementation, expose no package subpath, and clean consumers cannot import questpie/runtime or @questpie/runtime.

The release manifest pins exact tarball and public declaration SHA-256 digests. Dry-run packs twice with byte-identical output, rejects a changed committed digest, installs into a clean consumer, imports the public root, checks negative imports, and builds the archive fixture through the installed CLI.

The installed CLI provides build, check, migration apply, and start. Migration apply consumes committed migration bytes and treats an already-applied head as an idempotent successful retry; start requires the database URL and a bounded realtime HMAC key, serves the generated Runtime, and drains on SIGINT or SIGTERM.

The same checked tarball drives the existing collaboration Reaction tracer and the materially different archive permit, embargo, watch, and recovered-Reaction tracer. Their active generated application bytes come from the packed CLI rather than a workspace compiler import.

Local PostgreSQL 17 and remote CNPG PostgreSQL 18 direct evidence both pass the complete packed scenario. The selected Supabase profile remains honestly WITHHELD/MISSING_CREDENTIAL rather than being fabricated as PASS; the owner explicitly ruled that provider-specific run non-blocking, while a future credential changes the report only after the identical scenario actually passes.

The package test covers clean install, negative private imports, checksum mismatch, migration application and retry, Runtime start and graceful termination, and both connected tracers without weakening their nondisclosure, fresh Policy, transaction, retry, cancellation, or durable ownership assertions.

Public beta.1 documentation states the package, commands, required environment, generated-artifact boundary, and release boundary. It does not claim credential Auth, automatic publication, Studio, raw Routes, OpenAPI, MCP, or deferred capabilities.

Publication remains fail-closed outside a tag-triggered GitHub Actions npm environment and runs bun ci plus quality:release before npm publish --provenance. Dry-run never publishes; actual tag creation and environment approval remain human release decisions.

All sixteen committed performance manifests validate, every BETA-01 through BETA-12 slice owns evidence, and the BETA-12 packed release dry-run remains below its 15000 ms local budget. GitHub timing is informational and the tagged stable runner remains the strict release owner.

The closure record discloses rather than hides two inherited production boundaries: transaction-pool compatibility was not executed, and the current Runtime implements periodic realtime reconciliation rather than the artifact-declared listenNotify acceleration. Instant cross-instance notification and production connection routing require a separate Runtime closure with direct evidence; they are not inferred from this packaging slice.
